title: Knight's Armament Company SR-25 7.62x51 marksman rifle

infobox.trader: Ref LL2, Peacekeeper LL3: Black, Taupe

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - The taupe color attachments added with patch 1.0.1.0.42625 were described as addition of the "M110 SASS marksman rifle", while there was no new lower receiver or named variant added. The M110 SASS is based on the SR-25, but not exactly the same weapon and basically an SR-25 with a military-spec attachment package and small enhancements.
